messages.author: 0a0f6b3311f260d7
messages.subject: unexpected physignal error
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to calculate phylogenetic signal from my shape data using the "physignal" geomorph function. I have used this function many times before and am suddenly encoutering an error that I have never seen. I can only assume it has to do with an update to a relevant package, but have so far been unsuccessful in trying to fix it.

When I run my usual line of code:
> physignal(A=landmarks.gpa$coords, phy= tree, iter=999)

I get this error:
Error in ordinate(x, A = C, newdata = anc.BM(phy, x)) : 
  Expected a phyloseq object or otu_table object.

Has anyone else ever seen this error, or know how to fix it?

Thanks in advance!
Jaimi

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] unexpected physignal error
parts:
Hi Jaimi,

That particular error means you are using the version of geomorph on the Development branch of Github, which is a repository for the geomorph functions we are developing, which could be in various states of development, and with no guarantee to be bug-free.  You should install geomorph from the Stable branch of github and try again.

Best,
Mike
